title: Andrew Ng launches OpenWorker AI co-worker with seamless #andrewyng #openworker #machinelearning
description: Andrew Ng released OpenWorker, an AI co-worker that delivers finished work instead of just chatting. OpenWorker integrates with over 40 apps like Slack, Calendar, and Files, automating tasks such as preparing briefs, replying in Slack, and updating calendars while always seeking user approval before making changes. Built to run entirely on your Mac, OpenWorker supports various AI models including Fable, GPT 5.6, Sol, Kimi K3, DeepSeek, and Olama, ensuring your data stays local unless you choose otherwise. This innovation redefines AI collaboration by combining powerful automation with strong privacy controls, advancing productivity in the AI and workflow automation space. OpenWorker signals a shift towards more autonomous AI tools that work seamlessly within existing applications, enhancing efficiency and data security for professionals and enterprises. #AndrewNg #OpenWorker #AIcoworker #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #AIautomation #GoogleBrain #BaiduAI #MacAI #ProductivityTech #WorkflowAutomation #GPT56 #LocalAI #PrivacyFirstAI #AItools
